results.title: Visible navigation reaches all required business workflows
results.expected: Visible, interactive navigation for purchases, previous bills, masters and payment ledger
results.note: Hidden sidebar links and scripted nav() are not counted as mobile acceptance.

results.title: Baseline-supported supplier-issued numbers are scoped to supplier identity
results.expected: Supplier p2 P-1 and supplier p3 P-1 are distinct histories, as the baseline UI supports
results.note: Resolve supplier/FY uniqueness policy explicitly; never rewrite existing vendor numbers to manufacture global uniqueness.

results.title: Invoice CSV rejects malformed financial input rather than silently coercing it to zero
results.expected: Invalid explicit paid value rejected without byte changes

results.title: Quoted and multiline CSV fields preserve exact master values on reimport
Spreadsheet exports neutralize stored formula prefixes
results.expected: Spreadsheet cell is a literal stored name, not an active formula
results.note: No spreadsheet executable was opened; emitted bytes prove the unneutralized prefix, not execution in a physical Office installation.

results.title: Own invoice CSV preserves subtotal/discount/tax/total arithmetic
results.expected: Own export subtotal 100 − discount 10 + tax 0 = total 90

results.title: Party opening receivable is reflected consistently in displayed outstanding
results.expected: 25 opening receivable + two invoices with 80 due each = 185
results.note: Whether party openingBal is informational or an actual receivable requires owner policy; it is never silently discarded from stored bytes.

results.title: Supported legacy amount field reconciles with the item financial report
results.expected: Legacy qty 2 × rate 3 / saved amount 6 contributes 6 to Total Amount without rewriting bytes

results.title: Generated A5 printable invoice retains 40 lines and financial totals
results.expected: Every selected line and total remains visible; A5 is two copies on A4, without silent clipping
